**Frame:** Recto reveal. A hard date cut. At the top edge, one line of the flat configuration register from [page 016](016.md) carries across, then stops: a reinforcement-learning run beginning for an internal-only model that will never be released. Below it, in full incident register, a completely different task header: spreadsheet cells, several empty columns, and citations pointing to external Drive documents.

**Screen / system text:**
`7 MAY 2026 — A TRAINING RUN BEGINS`

`8 MAY 2026`

**Provenance:** `documented` — the 7 May kickoff and the internal-only, never-released status come from `OAI-BH` 10:04 and remain in the configuration register; the 8 May date and task type come from `OAI-TR`. Sheet layout is editorial.
